Short title and commencement

KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ARMS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
KHYBER
PAKHTUNKHWA ARMS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
An Act to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Arms Act, 2013
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Arms (Amendment) Act, 2015.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkwha Arms Amendment Act 2015
sections.description:
Amendment of section 15 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXIII of 2013

KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ARMS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
KHYBER
PAKHTUNKHWA ARMS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
An Act to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Arms Act, 2013
2. Amendment of section 15 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXIII of 2013.---
In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Arms Act, 2013 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXIII of 2013).
(i) the existing section 15,
after the heading Penalty for breach of sections 4, 5, 8, 9, 10 and 11 , shall
be re-numbered as sub-section (1) of section 15, and in sub-section (1), as so
re- numbered, the colon before the proviso shall be replaced by full stop and
thereafter the existing proviso shall be deleted; and
(ii) after sub-section (1) of
section 15, as so re-numbered, the following new sub-section shall be added,
namely:
(2) the offences under sub-section (1), shall be bailable:
Provided that the offence in respect of prohibited bore
weapons shall be non-bailable and shall be punishable
with imprisonment for a term not less than three years. .
BY ORDER OF
MR. SPEAKER
PROVINCIAL
ASSEMBLY OF KHYBER
PAKHTUNKHWA
